title: Frequently Asked Questions
body: Everything you need to know about billing, plans, and upgrades.

refund.a: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Contact support with your order number and we'll process the refund within 3–5 business days.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Log into your account and hit Cancel on the billing page. No questions asked.

upgrade.a: Yes, upgrade any time. You'll be charged the difference and the new plan takes effect immediately.

phone.a: Not at this time. Email or live chat is the fastest path to us.
